title: Dumbbell Only 8 week v2
author: Steve-o
desc:
Dumbbell Hypertrophy + Cut — Upper/Lower, 4 Days

A 4-day dumbbell program for muscle growth and fat loss, built to run in about 45 minutes. All you need is a pair of dumbbells (adjustable ideal — a heavier pair plus a light pair) and an adjustable bench. Upper/Lower split trains each muscle twice a week, which is the sweet spot for growth.

Schedule: Day 1 Upper A (push bias) · Day 2 Lower A · rest · Day 3 Upper B (pull bias) · Day 4 Lower B · 2 rest days. Exercises are supersetted (A1/A2, B1/B2, C1/C2) — do one set of each back-to-back, then rest. Warm up 5 minutes first.

Progression — double progression on load: pick a weight, stay in the rep range, add reps each session until you hit the top of the range on every set, then add weight and reset reps to the bottom. That's the whole method. Rep ranges: compounds 8–12, accessories 10–15, delts and calves 15–20.

Rest — match it to the job: 90–120 s on the big compounds (bench, row, press, squat, RDL) so you can lift heavy across all sets; 45–60 s on accessories and isolation to keep the pace up and add a conditioning hit.

8-week structure: Weeks 1–2 ease in (leave 3–4 reps in the tank). Weeks 3–4 build load. Week 5 deload (lighter, half the sets). Weeks 6–7 heaviest. Week 8 peak, then reassess. Don't skip the deload — it's what makes the hard weeks possible.

Shoulder-friendly: neutral-grip pressing, control the descent and only go as deep as stays pain-free, set the backrest near-vertical for seated presses. Avoid upright rows, behind-the-neck pressing, and deep dips.

For fat loss: the training keeps your muscle — the deficit strips the fat. Pair this with a modest calorie deficit, protein around 1.6–2.2 g per kg bodyweight, and 7–10k steps a day. The supersets already give you a solid conditioning hit, so lean on daily steps for the rest.

ss.note: Blades pinned down+back, slight arch. Elbows ~45 deg from torso (not flared to 90). Lower under control to a pain-free depth, drive up. Dumbbells let you go deeper than a bar - earn that depth gradually. · Weights: 14 kg
Hinge ~45 deg, free hand braced on bench. Pull the bell to your HIP, lead with the elbow, let the shoulder blade move. This can go heavier than your press - push it.
Straight arms out as high as possible, turning thumbs down towards the floor.
Elbows down, sit BETWEEN the hips, knees track over toes, chest tall, controlled depth. 1xDumbbel · Weights: 14 kg
Soft knees, push hips BACK not down, bells drag close to thighs. Stop when the low back wants to round. Squeeze glutes to stand. (24 kg/side went well - keep climbing.)

Shoulder blades on the bench edge, feet flat and shins vertical at the top, bell across the hips (use a pad/towel). Drive through the HEELS, squeeze the glutes, ribs down - do not arch the low back. Master the movement light before you load it.
Weights: 14 kg
Reps Per Leg. Weights: 14 kg
